name: 游戏开黑
summary: 优先保证清晰度和低延迟，减少键盘和风扇干扰。

recommendedSettings.compressor: Ratio 3:1, Threshold -18 dB, Attack 8 ms, Release 90 ms
recommendedSettings.eq: HPF 80 Hz, cut 250 Hz slightly, boost 3 kHz slightly
notes: 麦克风离嘴 10 到 15 厘米
键盘机械轴噪声较大时，优先做摆位而不是重降噪

name: 唱歌
summary: 保留动态和空气感，同时避免近讲效应过强。

recommendedSettings.compressor: Ratio 2.5:1, Threshold -20 dB, Attack 20 ms, Release 120 ms
recommendedSettings.eq: HPF 70 Hz, tame 250 Hz if muddy, add 10 kHz air carefully
notes: 收音环境比插件更重要
强混响前先把原始人声录干净

name: 直播带货
summary: 突出稳定、靠前的人声，确保平台端听感一致。

recommendedSettings.compressor: Ratio 4:1, Threshold -16 dB, Attack 5 ms, Release 70 ms
recommendedSettings.eq: HPF 90 Hz, cut 300 Hz slightly, presence boost 4 kHz
notes: 注意环境空调噪声与回声
避免边播边开外放，优先耳返

name: 播客
summary: 保持自然和耐听，少做激进处理。

recommendedSettings.noiseGate: Very light expander instead of a hard gate
recommendedSettings.compressor: Ratio 2:1, Threshold -18 dB, Attack 15 ms, Release 110 ms
recommendedSettings.eq: HPF 75 Hz, gentle low-mid cleanup, small boost around 2.5 kHz
notes: 多说话人录制时统一话筒距离
